name: agent_trades
_description: Agente de Oficios (B72-fase-C). Genera trade_requests (una por cada especialidad necesaria: albanileria, fontaneria, electricidad, carpinteria, climatizacion, pintura, etc.) a partir de design_option + cost_estimate. Patron running->completed.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, project_type, location_province, location_city, property_area_m2, urgency FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, intervention_logic, rooms_layout FROM design_options WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'selected' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, version, total_estimated, breakdown FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_trades', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ project_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, design_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.design_id, cost_estimate_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.cost_estimate_id }), JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.request_id, source: 'api_trades_generate' })] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO trade_requests (project_id, trade_type, description, quantity_units, expected_budget_eur, urgency, status)
SELECT $1::uuid,
       (req->>'trade_type')::text,
       (req->>'description')::text,
       (req->'quantity_units')::jsonb,
       (req->>'expected_budget_eur')::numeric,
       (req->>'urgency')::text,
       'open'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS req
RETURNING id, trade_type
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), output = $2::jsonb, metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Start Execution').first().json.id, JSON.stringify({ trade_count: $('Format Response').first().json.trade_count, orden_recomendado: $('Format Response').first().json.output.orden_recomendado }), JSON.stringify({ model: $('Format Response').first().json.model, tokens_in: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_in, tokens_out: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_out, eu_ai_act: 'asistencia profesional supervisada' })] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { project_id: $('Format Response').first().json.project_id, trade_count: $('Format Response').first().json.trade_count, trade_requests: $('Format Response').first().json.output.trade_requests, orden_recomendado: $('Format Response').first().json.output.orden_recomendado, notes: $('Format Response').first().json.output.notes }, meta: { request_id: $('Format Response').first().json.request_id, model: $('Format Response').first().json.model, tokens_in: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_in, tokens_out: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_out, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }}) }}
